name: BooKoo Mini Scale
author: Roy Ackerman; Decaid contributors
description: BooKoo Themis Mini BLE scale with optional firmware v1.4.2 keep-awake and power-off support.

Firmware142Commands.label: Enable firmware v1.4.2 power commands
Firmware142Commands.description: Enable only after installing Themis Mini firmware v1.4.2 or later. Leave off for v1.4.1. Enables the two power options below; firmware cannot be detected automatically.

KeepAwake.label: Keep scale awake while connected
KeepAwake.description: Requires the firmware power commands above. Resets the scale's auto-off countdown on connection and every 60 seconds. Enable Decaid scale power management to disconnect when the machine sleeps.

PowerOffOnDisconnect.label: Power off on intentional disconnect
PowerOffOnDisconnect.description: Requires the firmware power commands above. Sends shutdown before a healthy scale disconnects, including machine sleep, manual disconnect and switching scales. Plugin reload/unload and connection failures skip shutdown.

PacketTimeoutMs.label: Weight notification timeout (milliseconds)
PacketTimeoutMs.description: Reports a lost protocol stream to Decaid after this many milliseconds without a valid weight packet. Default 2000; allowed range 1000 to 30000. Increase only if hardware testing shows a slower normal notification cadence.
